shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright monolithic slab/pillar
horizontal registers or bands of repeated motifs
schematic limb/arm forms rendered in shallow relief
row of repeated arch- or crescent-shaped elements (A: brow/ear features; B: three arched motifs)
justification: Both are upright monolithic surfaces carved in flat, schematic low relief with a disc motif and stacked bands of repeated elements, which gives a loose formal kinship in carving convention. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows a single anthropomorphic figure with head, arms, belt and chest disc, while B shows registers of arched fringed objects above a row of profile animals (quadruped, bird, snake) with no human figure at all.
